name: Geoprocessing Item Class Profile
title: Geoprocessing item classes
abstract: A profile of the Activity Type Register Profile for geoprocessing activity types
description: Geoprocessing activities (reprojection, clipping, index computation, classification, model inference over imagery) are distinguished from other activities by the kind of data they use and produce. This block adds geoproc:GeoprocessingActivity, a sub-class of prov:Activity that every registered geoprocessing activity type specialises. It also constrains the related PROV object types such a type declares: at least one acttype:usedEntityType or acttype:generatedEntityType must be a GeoSPARQL 1.1 spatial type (geo:SpatialObject or geo:SpatialObjectCollection, or a sub-class of either).
